title: pyrus × robertsonii
intro: Pyrus × robertsonii, commonly known as Robert's pear, is a hybrid plant species in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus × robertsonii include analgesic, antipyretic, and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate pain, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
